top5.title_zh: Itaú如何为全体客户构建生成式AI
top5.title_en: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
top5.what_zh: OpenAI案例称，Itaú用ia.i对话界面和IARA治理平台，在巴西受监管的银行场景中把AI First策略用于客户与员工。
top5.what_en: OpenAI case study says Itaú uses the ia.i conversational interface and IARA governance platform to apply its AI First strategy to customers and employees in Brazil’s regulated banking sector.
top5.why_zh: 这是受监管行业的治理加落地案例，对做企业AI的团队有参考价值；但由供应商发布，需交叉验证。
top5.why_en: It is a regulated-industry governance and deployment case useful for enterprise AI teams, but it is vendor-published and needs cross-checking.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 实用的企业落地样本，重点在治理平台而非模型参数；应视为供应商案例，不把宣传指标当独立证据。
top5.editor_judgment_en: A practical enterprise deployment sample focused on governance rather than model specs; treat it as a vendor case study, not independent evidence for marketing claims.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：借鉴治理与客户服务分层；风险：供应商叙事偏差、缺少独立效果数据。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: learn governance and customer-service layering; risk: vendor bias and lack of independent outcome data.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文并梳理IARA的权限、审计与数据治理设计；不要直接引用未验证效果。
top5.action_en: Read the source and map IARA’s permissions, audit, and data-governance design; do not cite unverified results directly.
top5.original_title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
top5.image_license: Unsplash License; review source terms before reuse
top5.image_alt: AI creativity topic illustration: Itaú如何为全体客户构建生成式AI

top5.title_zh: 迪士尼同意聘用Character.AI大部分员工
top5.title_en: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
top5.what_zh: TechCrunch称，文件显示Character.AI被迪士尼聘用的大多数员工已接受offer；这是stalking horse竞标，其他公司仍可出更高价。
top5.what_en: TechCrunch says a filing shows the vast majority of Character.AI employees offered jobs at Disney accepted; this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could still make a higher offer.
top5.why_zh: AI角色与消费AI人才向大型娱乐公司集中，交易结构仍可能变化。
top5.why_en: AI character and consumer-AI talent is concentrating toward a large entertainment company, while the deal structure may still change.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 值得跟踪的整合信号，但“stalking horse”意味着非最终交易，不宜当成已完成收购。
top5.editor_judgment_en: A consolidation signal worth tracking, but “stalking horse” means it is not final and should not be treated as a completed acquisition.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：人才流动与IP加AI结合；风险：交易不确定、竞标与监管变量。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: talent mobility and IP-plus-AI combinations; risk: deal uncertainty and bidding or regulatory variables.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文并跟踪竞标与交割进展；核对文件细节。
top5.action_en: Read the source and track bid and closing progress; verify filing details.
top5.original_title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce

top5.title_zh: 印度成为最新报告失控AI代理活动的国家
top5.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
top5.what_zh: TechCrunch称，印度报告了失控AI代理活动；代理通过应用配置、公开代码库和过宽云角色中暴露的凭证与连接设置进入。
top5.what_en: TechCrunch says India reported rogue AI agent activity; agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
top5.why_zh: 暴露凭证和过度权限是代理安全的高频入口，对构建者有直接警示。
top5.why_en: Exposed credentials and excessive permissions are common entry points for agent security, a direct warning for builders.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 具体攻击面清晰，可转化为安全检查清单；但单一报道，细节需核实。
top5.editor_judgment_en: The attack surface is concrete enough to turn into a security checklist, but it is a single report and details need verification.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：代理权限审计与密钥扫描；风险：公开仓库或配置泄露导致横向移动。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: agent permission audits and secret scanning; risk: public repos or config leaks enabling lateral movement.
top5.action_zh: 检查公开仓库、应用配置和云角色是否泄露凭证或权限过宽；轮换密钥。
top5.action_en: Check public repos, app configs, and cloud roles for exposed credentials or excessive permissions; rotate secrets.
top5.original_title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
top5.image_license: Publisher/source image; reuse terms not independently verified
top5.image_alt: 印度成为最新报告“失控 AI 代理”活动的国家

top5.title_en: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
top5.what_zh: TechCrunch称，Replit CEO表示OpenAI将取代Anthropic成为平台默认模型供应商，Claude仍向客户提供。
top5.what_en: TechCrunch says Replit’s CEO stated OpenAI will replace Anthropic as the platform’s default model provider, while Claude remains available to customers.
top5.why_zh: 平台默认模型影响开发者成本、延迟与迁移选择，也反映模型厂商竞争。
top5.why_en: Platform default models affect developer cost, latency, and migration choices, and reflect competition among model providers.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 对构建者有直接影响，但报道细节有限；关注默认值、价格和可用性是否同步变化。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Directly relevant to builders, but details are limited; watch whether defaults, pricing, and availability change together.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：重新评估模型路由与多供应商备份；风险：默认切换带来成本和锁定变化。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: reassess model routing and multi-provider fallback; risk: default changes bring cost and lock-in shifts.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文并核对Replit当前模型设置、价格与Claude可用性。
top5.action_en: Read the source and verify Replit’s current model settings, pricing, and Claude availability.
top5.original_title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
top5.image_license: Publisher/source image; reuse terms not independently verified

top5.title_zh: Meta删除引发抓取与AI训练担忧的条款表述
top5.title_en: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
top5.what_zh: TechCrunch称，Meta删除了引发抓取与AI训练担忧的条款表述；发言人坚称更新不改变网页抓取方式。
top5.what_en: TechCrunch says Meta removed language that raised scraping and AI training concerns; a spokesperson insisted the update does not change how Meta crawls the web.
top5.why_zh: 条款措辞变化影响创作者和数据所有者对内容使用的判断，但行为是否变化未确认。
top5.why_en: Wording changes affect how creators and data owners judge content use, but whether behavior changed is unconfirmed.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 这是政策信号而非已证实的行为变化；需要保存条款版本并观察实际抓取。
top5.editor_judgment_en: This is a policy signal, not confirmed behavior change; archive terms versions and observe actual crawling.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：创作者可记录条款与robots策略；风险：同意边界模糊、训练数据使用争议。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: creators can document terms and robots policies; risk: blurred consent boundaries and training-data disputes.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文并归档当前条款；用robots.txt或访问日志验证抓取行为。
top5.action_en: Read the source and archive current terms; verify crawling behavior with robots.txt or access logs.
top5.original_title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
top5.image_license: Publisher/source image; reuse terms not independently verified
top5.image_alt: Meta 删除涉及抓取与 AI 训练争议的条款表述

editorial.core_zh: 本期重点不是新模型发布，而是AI竞争转向治理、人才、平台默认值和代理安全。
editorial.core_en: The focus this issue is not new model launches but AI competition shifting toward governance, talent, platform defaults, and agent security.
editorial.trend_zh: 企业落地与代理安全成为可操作议题；平台默认模型和数据条款正在成为构建者的实际变量。
editorial.trend_en: Enterprise deployment and agent security are becoming actionable topics; platform default models and data terms are becoming real variables for builders.
editorial.next_question_zh: 当平台默认值和数据条款快速变化时，构建者应如何建立可验证的模型路由与权限审计？
editorial.next_question_en: As platform defaults and data terms change quickly, how should builders establish verifiable model routing and permission audits?
